Players Committee card image of [[Blizzard 8]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/blizzard_8.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/blizzard_8.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
